data.documentType: medical record (records production with billing summary)
data.summary: Mercy Test Hospital records production for Riley Sample covering 2026-03-14 through 2026-06-30, after a motor vehicle collision on 2026-03-14. Treatment included ED care, primary care, physical therapy, an MRI showing an L4-L5 disc herniation, an orthopedic consult and an epidural steroid injection. The stated total of $13,900.00 does not match the sum of the line items ($13,800.00). Physical therapy had a 46-day break, but other treatment continued during it.
